newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on February 7:
WASHINGTON - President Bill Clinton sent Congress a five-year plan to balance the federal budget, cut middle-class taxes and expand the national role in education.
WASHINGTON - White House officials called President Bill Clinton's new budget the most fiscally responsible tax and spending package in recent memory.
WASHINGTON - President Bill Clinton and first lady Hillary Rodham Clinton used the National Prayer Breakfast to call for the end of anger and cynicism in America.
WASHINGTON - Nearly three-quarters of all the murders of children in the industrialized world occur in the United States, federal health officials said.
MEXICO CITY - Another key Mexican has disappeared in the saga of murder, betrayal and corruption swirling around Carlos and Raul Salinas de Gortari, the former president and his brother.
WASHINGTON - The frigid waters of the Potomac River nearly claimed the life of a 3-year-old Bethesda girl after her family went out for a sail on a warm winter's day last week.

MOSCOW - President Boris Yeltsin's two senior lieutenants warned the West this week that NATO expansion could unleash a new military buildup, stoke the fires of nationalism and undermine the young Russian democracy.
